text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a Trainer, learning about foreign 
racing circuits is crucial. Thinking that, 
I traveled abroad, only to end up 
completely lost on site...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, what a surprise. I never expected 
to run into a Tracen Academy Trainer in a 
place like this.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Do I travel often? All the time. Whenever 
the mood strikes me.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't call it sightseeing. Nor am I 
looking to study anything. To me, travel 
is—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Living itself," that is. I've traveled to 
so many different places. Always, 
throughout my life.
choice_data_list: For example, what kind of places?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
All sorts of places. Places I can name, 
places I can't quite describe, all over, 
really.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
As if driven by something unseen. Or 
perhaps――as if being guided.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A flame in the bonfireââsnapped and 
popped once.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hey, let me ask you something.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If there's something waiting at the end of 
the journey, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What lies beyond the journey." It was a 
sudden question, but when I try to picture 
it――
choice_data_list: Onto the next journey, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I see... That makes sense. I never truly 
felt like I had reached my final 
destination.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
No, maybe there was once. But that 
place... was just a stop along the way.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, that was fun. Let's meet up again 
somewhere!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I see. That is true... Even if there was 
no treasure, a immense sense of relief 
washed over me upon finishing the journey.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
A profound sense of fulfillment from 
walking the whole way, and then... the 
most exquisite sleep.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Maybe this is all I need. Anything more or 
less might just be asking for too much.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well then, good night, wandering poet. 
Meeting you has been its own sort of 
solace.
